title: Gluing affine effective models with locally invariant projection
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a singleton fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering] of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $D$ be a descent datum on $V\to X$ [def-pd-descent-datum]. For each affine open $U\subset S$, set $X_U=X\times_S U$ and $V_U=V\times_X X_U$, using the chosen fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product]. Suppose $V_U$ has an effective datum $E_U$ for $X_U\to U$, and projection $V_U\to V$ intertwines its transport with that of $D$ for pairs of points of $X_U$ with the same image in $U$. There exist $W\to S$ and $q:V\to W$ exhibiting $V$ as the pullback of $W$ along $f$, such that for every $U$ and pair of test points $a,b:T\to X_U$ with equal image in $U$, transport by $D$ of a point of $V_U$ projected to $V$ leaves its composite with $q$ unchanged.

lean.statement: theorem fpqc_affine_effective_models_glue {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (hf : Presieve.singleton f ∈ Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage S) {V : Over X} (D : Over.DescentDatum f V) (hlocal : ∀ U : S.affineOpens, ∃ E : Over.DescentDatum (pullback.snd f U.1.ι) (Over.mk (pullback.snd V.hom (pullback.fst f U.1.ι))), E.IsEffective ∧ ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (a b : T ⟶ pullback f U.1.ι) (hab : a ≫ pullback.snd f U.1.ι = b ≫ pullback.snd f U.1.ι) (x : Over.mk a ⟶ Over.mk (pullback.snd V.hom (pullback.fst f U.1.ι))), (D.transport (a ≫ pullback.fst f U.1.ι) (b ≫ pullback.fst f U.1.ι) (by simp only [Category.assoc, pullback.condition]; rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, hab]) (Over.homMk (x.left ≫ pullback.fst V.hom (pullback.fst f U.1.ι)) (by simpa [Category.assoc, pullback.condition] using congrArg (fun z ↦ z ≫ pullback.fst f U.1.ι) (Over.w x)))).left = (E.transport a b hab x).left ≫ pullback.fst V.hom (pullback.fst f U.1.ι)) : ∃ (W : Over S) (q : V.left ⟶ W.left), IsPullback q V.hom W.hom f ∧ ∀ (U : S.affineOpens) {T : Scheme.{u}} (a b : T ⟶ pullback f U.1.ι) (hab : a ≫ pullback.snd f U.1.ι = b ≫ pullback.snd f U.1.ι) (x : Over.mk a ⟶ Over.mk (pullback.snd V.hom (pullback.fst f U.1.ι))), (D.transport (a ≫ pullback.fst f U.1.ι) (b ≫ pullback.fst f U.1.ι) (by simp only [Category.assoc, pullback.condition]; rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, hab]) (Over.homMk (x.left ≫ pullback.fst V.hom (pullback.fst f U.1.ι)) (by simpa [Category.assoc, pullback.condition] using congrArg (fun z ↦ z ≫ pullback.fst f U.1.ι) (Over.w x)))).left ≫ q = x.left ≫ pullback.fst V.hom (pullback.fst f U.1.ι) ≫ q
